title: The grace of the new covenant promised in Ezekiel
source_text: IV. Hanc gratiam, tanquam pertinentem ad novum foedus in Christo ineundum, Deus per Prophetas saepius promisit. Sic enim loquitur Deus apud Ezechielem, cap. 11. Dabo eis cor unum, & spiritum novum tribuam in visceribus eorum: & auferam cor lapideum de carne eorum, & dabo eis cor carneum: ut in praeceptis meis ambulent, & judicia mea custodiant, faciantque ea: & sint mihi in populum, & ego sim eis in Deum. Et rursus cap. 36. Effundam super vos aquam mundam, & mundabimini ab omnibus inquinamentis vestris, & ab universis idolis vestris mundabo vos. Et dabo vobis cor novum, & spiritum novum ponam in medio vestri: & auferam cor lapideum de carne vestra, & dabo vobis cor carneum. Et spiritum meum ponam in medio vestri: & faciam ut in praeceptis meis ambuletis, & judicia mea custodiatis & operemini. Et habitabitis in terra quam dedi Patribus vestris: & eritis mihi in populum, & ego ero vobis in Deum.
pass_a_gloss: IV. This grace, as belonging to the new covenant to be made in Christ, God promised quite often through the Prophets. For thus God speaks in Ezekiel, chap. 11. I will give them one heart, & I will put a new spirit within them: & I will take away the stony heart from their flesh, & I will give them a heart of flesh: that they may walk in my precepts, & keep my judgments, and do them: & that they may be my people, & I may be their God. And again chap. 36. I will pour clean water upon you, & you shall be cleansed from all your filthiness, & from all your idols I will cleanse you. And I will give you a new heart, & put a new spirit in the midst of you: & I will take away the stony heart from your flesh, & give you a heart of flesh. And I will put my spirit in the midst of you: & I will cause you to walk in my precepts, & to keep my judgments & do them. And you shall dwell in the land which I gave to your Fathers: & you shall be my people, & I will be your God.
pass_b_english: Thesis IV. God often promised this grace through the prophets, as belonging to the new covenant to be made in Christ. In Ezekiel 11 he says: 'I will give them one heart and put a new spirit within them. I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh, so that they walk in my precepts, keep my judgments and do them, and so that they are my people and I am their God.'

And again in chapter 36: 'I will pour clean water on you, and you will be made clean from all your defilements; from all your idols I will cleanse you. I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you. I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh. I will put my Spirit within you and make you walk in my precepts, keep my judgments and carry them out. You will live in the land I gave your fathers; you will be my people, and I will be your God.'

lemmas.gloss: I will cause you to walk in my precepts

choices.why: The prophetic promise of the covenant of grace under which the law is written on the heart.
